meta.coverage: Worldwide satellite observations; cloud/overpass gaps apply. Countries and fire causes unverified.
meta.sampling: Priority per occupied 1-degree tile, then remaining priority; capped export
meta.frpAggregation: Sum of peak FRP per 0.01-degree event cell in rolling window, not simultaneous global power

context.facilities: WRI static reference: 11394 thermal plants; proximity only
context.places: GeoNames cities15000: 34107 cities; nearest place is not a border lookup

attribution: WRI Global Power Plant Database (CC BY 4.0), static proximity context
meta.weatherScope: Highest-FRP exported events only; defaults are excluded, stale wind is labeled
